title: state_counters i64 has no overflow guard
description: The state_counters.counter column is a SQLite INTEGER (i64). advance_state_counter_in_tx increments it with no bounds check. At i64::MAX the next UPDATE wraps to a negative value, producing state tokens like 's--9223372036854775808'. get_changes_since would then parse a negative since_counter, which is valid i64, but all subsequent comparisons break (state appears to have regressed). This is not reachable in normal use for a personal mailbox, but a check and clear error message on overflow would prevent a confusing silent failure.
